newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish consumer confidence rises in January-Gallup.
newsitem.headline: Danish consumer confidence rises in January-Gallup.

text.p: Danish consumer confidence rose in January 1997 to its highest level since October 1995, Gallup said in its latest consumer expectations index issued on Tuesday.
It said the index rose to 154.3 in January from 149.7 in December, attributing the rise in confidence to renewed optimism in prospects for the Danish business sector.
The average for 1995 was 156.7 and 142.2 in 1966, Gallup said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969650
